text: BNFC suggests giving neonates doxa- pram hydrochloride intravenously in an initial dose of 2.5 mg/kg over 5 to 10 minutes followed by 300 micrograms/kg per hour by continuous infusion, adjusted according to response, to a maxi- mum dose of 1.5 mg/kg per hour; alternatively, 6 mg/kg may be given orally 4 times daily after the initial intravenous dose. 1.
